notes: δεῖ takes must and ἡμᾶς takes we, the modal being what answers to the impersonal verb and the accusative subject of the infinitive being realized as the English subject.

ἐμμένειν keeps only to continue: rule 106's oblique-government arm gives the dative's in to the article τῇ along with the determiner under rule 21, an English verb word of its own standing for the compound.
τοῦ before θεοῦ is unrepresented under rules 21 and 23, the ASV giving God no determiner.
